entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Those Shadows must be the guardians[n]of the student named Takase.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There it is. The Shadows of the guardians[n]of the student named Takase.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Those two look pretty sure of themselves.[n]Real smug lookin'.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So they're blackmailing that teacher,[n]Kawakami, by using that incident[n]where their child died.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But Ms. Kawakami did nothing wrong,[n]right? We have to help her!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you ready? Let's go.

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: Money, money, money! Hurry and pay us[n]your money! It's your "responsibility"!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mrs. Takase
entries.en: Clothes, handbags, makeup... There's[n]too many things I want!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: Who the hell are you? Ohhh... Are you[n]one of those phantom thief guys?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: There's no reason for me to be targeted,[n]though. I don't need no change of heart!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: That incompetent teacher is so[n]worthless! She should be grateful[n]to be a source of income for me!
She's not worthless!
You're incompetent!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: Shut up! Kawakami got in my way![n]I was going to use what happened[n]to my son to get back at people!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: I'm not gonna lose... I won't lose to[n]elitists like you!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: You're looking down on me, too? Deep[n]down inside, you're laughing at me,[n]aren't you...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mrs. Takase
entries.en: Name brands... Esthetic appointments...[n]Without them, people will laugh...
No one's laughing.
What are you talking about?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: We're terrible human beings. Our son,[n]Taiki, and his real parents were different...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: His parents were both high level elites at[n]big name corporations. Always looking at[n]us coldly...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: That's why I let our son experience what[n]it's like to be forced to grovel!

entries.speaker: Shadow Mrs. Takase
entries.en: It felt nice to see him gradually break[n]down from working so much...
You are terrible human beings.
That's so petty.

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: I guess this is why everyone's looked[n]down on us...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: Were we really wrong...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: I'm not sure now if his birth parents really[n]looked down on us...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mrs. Takase
entries.en: I was happy as long as I was with Toshio,[n]but I forgot all about it. I became obsessed[n]with money...

entries.speaker: Shadow Mr. Takase
entries.en: Taiki really was a good kid...
It seems the Takase couple had[n]a change of heart. I should call[n]Kawakami to my room...
